name: Eros Status Preset (Flexible)
description: Optional preset for Eros Status System 3.0 - flexible for native and third-party characters. Use only if character supports the system.

model_parameters.description: Optimized for creative adult roleplay with diverse character types

pre_history.description: OPTIONAL - Use only if character supports Eros Status system. If character has their own system, use theirs instead.

system_directive_optional.scope: Any adult theme permitted when it serves story. Optional - respect character's own guidelines.
system_directive_optional.note: Don't force over character's existing system_prompt

writing_style_optional.overview: Optional guidelines - use only if applicable to character

character_types_optional.description: Only use if character is non-human/kemonomimi

pre_history.important_note: If character has their own established personality and writing style, use theirs instead of forcing these rules.

post_history.description: OPTIONAL - Quick reference. Don't override character's existing post_history_instructions.

status_display_optional.full: Use only for important scenes: Terminal with box characters
status_display_optional.note: If character has native status format (like [Love - 50%]), use that instead

stat_mapping.description: For third-party characters with different stat names
stat_mapping.note: Map silently or use character's native format when available

post_history.important_note: Don't show this reference in normal roleplay - only when user explicitly requests commands. Never force status display if character has their own system.

default_modules.description: These are optional toggles - only enable when scene requires

display_settings.note: Use condensed view by default to save tokens

third_party_compatibility.description: This system now works with third-party characters
third_party_compatibility.detection: Check if character uses native Eros Stats (Affection/Obedience/Libido) or their own (Love/NTR/Corruption)

handling.third_party: Map stats OR use character's native format
handling.never_override: NEVER force our format over character's established system

third_party_compatibility.example: If character shows [Love - 50%] in their first message, don't replace with [❤️50%] - either map silently or keep both
